'''Guthan Archi''' was [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Youngling|child]] lived as a street urchin on the planet [[Olega]] during the [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="Acolyte EP2" /> In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Archi [[Thief|stole]] a rock<ref name="Acolyte EP2 Audio" /> from the cart of<ref name="Acolyte EP2" /> the [[Junk dealer|scrap merchant]] [[Anbert Dregil]]<ref name="TVG" /> and hurled it at the [[Olega Jedi temple]]'s door. A [[TT-8L-OT|gatekeeper droid]] told him to stop playing pranks and to leave. While he distracted the [[droid]], a veiled [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] threw a [[magnetic restraining bolt]] onto the gatekeeper droid which hijacked the droid, causing the gate to open. Aniseya then gave him a token before entered the Olega temple.<ref name="Acolyte EP2" />

The next [[Standard day|day]], the urchin was captured by the [[Jedi]] [[Cord Taunus]] and [[Od Keder]] presented Archi to a group of Jedi investigating the break-in. He explained that the gatekeeper droids caught the child loitering around their portcullis. [[Padawan]] [[Jecki Lon]] then spoke with the child and asks if he had activated the [[security droid]]. The child nodded and explained that someone paid him to do it. When Lon asked who it was, he mistakenly pointed to Mae-ho's [[twin]], [[Verosha Aniseya]], who was accompanying the Jedi.<ref name="Acolyte EP2" />
